name: odoo_generate_tests
description:
Auto-generate production-grade Odoo TransactionCase unit tests for a target model Python file.

    Parses model definition, fields, and state machine methods via AST, and writes a robust
    automated test suite covering complete lifecycle flows, cancellation policies, multi-company isolation,
    and unassigned relational navigation.

    Args:
        model_path: Path to the Python model file.
        output_path: Optional destination path (defaults to sibling tests/test_<clean_model>.py).

    Returns:
        Confirmation with output path and preview of generated test code.
